metadata.name: Incident Response Core Infrastructure
metadata.description: Complete incident response plan for detecting, responding to, and recovering from security incidents.

sev1-critical.definition: Data breach, encryption key compromise, system down

sev2-high.definition: Unauthorized access, malware detected, audit log tampering

sev3-medium.definition: Suspicious activity, rate limit exceeded, failed validation

sev4-low.escalation: Log and review in next security meeting

roles.responsibility: Investigate incident, contain threat, preserve evidence

triggers: Anomaly detection (unusual access patterns, data exfiltration)

containment.step1: Isolate affected system (disconnect from network if necessary)
containment.step2: Preserve evidence (copy logs, memory dumps, database state)
containment.step3: Stop the attack (block IP, revoke credentials, shutdown service)
containment.step4: Communicate status (update incident board, notify stakeholders)

investigation.step1: Timeline: When did attack start? When was it detected?
investigation.step2: Scope: What systems affected? What data accessed?
investigation.step3: Root cause: How did attacker get in? What was the vulnerability?
investigation.step4: Impact: Which users affected? What data was exposed?

internal: Notify affected users within 72 hours (if data exposed)
Notify board within 24 hours (if material breach)
external: Notify regulators: IRS (if tax data), state AG (if resident data), ICO (if GDPR)
Notify law enforcement (if criminal activity suspected)
Public disclosure (if material + required by law)

dataBreachPII.scenario: Attacker gains access to database with SSN, addresses, DOB
immediateActions: Take database offline if still being accessed
Check what data was actually accessed
response: Offer free credit monitoring for 2 years
Notify IRS (if tax data breach, per Pub 1075)

immediateActions: Immediately revoke compromised key in KMS
Audit all data decrypted with key since compromise
recovery: Re-encrypt all data with new key (high priority: recent sensitive data)
Destroy compromised key after retention period

immediateActions: Do NOT process file through system
analysis: Review when file was uploaded, who uploaded it

immediateActions: Scale auto-scaling groups to handle load
recovery: Once attack stops, analyze traffic patterns
Implement rate limiting on affected endpoints

unauthorizedAccess.scenario: User accessing other users' documents (authorization bypass)

notificationContent.what_they_do: What should users do? (Credit monitoring, password reset, etc.)

drills.scenario: Simulate data breach; test response procedures
drills.measure: Time to detect, contain, notify, and recover

tabletop.scenario: Discuss how to handle specific incident

contacts: CISO, CEO, legal, compliance officer, insurance broker

insurance.requirement: Cyber liability insurance covering data breach costs

preRequisites: Legal agreement with incident response vendors
